Field.Name: Name
Field.EnergyShieldCompatible: May be worn with an energy shield

Hint.Wyrd: Derived from your occult path, plus any bonus (p.125).
Hint.WoundPenalty: Wound penalty from lost vital levels (p.125). Applied automatically to Goal Rolls.
Hint.SpiritPairs: Each pair is opposed; tick the trait that is primary (p.93).
Hint.ExcessiveGoal: Bonus Victory Points from a Goal Number above 20 (p.66).
Hint.PullPunch: Ctrl-click to pull the punch and use only one victory die (p.65).
Hint.EffectDice: Effect dice succeed on 1–4; each success is one point (p.65).
Hint.Range: Ranges are in metres: short and long. Long range costs -2 to the goal roll, and anything beyond it is Extreme at -4 (p.296).
Hint.Armour: Armour dice are rolled without victory dice. Each armour point cancels one wound point (p.65). Wielding a weapon below its Strength requirement costs -2 to the goal roll (p.296).
Hint.Skill: Natural skills start at 3; learned skills must be bought (p.97, p.99).
Hint.OccultCost: Wyrd is spent only if the roll succeeds, or on a critical failure (p.128).
Hint.Accent: Spend one Wyrd point to add to your die result — but beware of overshooting the Goal (p.69).
Hint.Restriction: The situation that activates the modifier. If it does not come into play, the modifier does not apply (p.115).
Hint.BlessingLimit: No more than seven Blessing modifiers, nor more than seven points of Curses (p.115).
Hint.Ranks: Set the Points field to the rank bought. Gamemasters may price entries outside this table.
Hint.BeneficePoints: Afflictions do not enlarge this budget — they grant Extra points instead (p.117).
Hint.Stage: Drag a stage from the Character Histories compendium onto a character to record it.
Hint.ExtraPoints: Extra points are the only way to buy Blessings, occult characteristics and powers. Curses and Afflictions grant more (p.88).
Hint.CombatAction: Combat actions are rated by the level of skill needed to learn them, and cost one Extra point per level (p.102, p.88).
Hint.ExtraStages: A character may take two Extra Stages, at 20 Extra points each — which is the whole allowance (p.84). Take fewer to keep points for Step Six.
Hint.PathChain: Paths are bought consecutively: each level needs the one below it in the same path (p.128).
Hint.Components: G is a gesture, L a spoken litany, P paraphernalia. A rite cannot be performed without them (p.147).
Hint.OccultLevels: Leave blank to use the lowest level of the printed band. The gamemaster decides where in the band a deed falls.

Empty.Skills: No natural skills. Add the nine natural skills to begin.
Empty.Modifiers: No modifiers. Add them in the source data or edit the compendium entry.

ApplyWoundPenalties.Name: Apply Wound Penalties Automatically
ApplyWoundPenalties.Hint: Subtract the wound penalty from lost vital levels (p.125) from every Goal Roll.

BeneficePoints.Name: Benefice Points at Creation
BeneficePoints.Hint: The rulebook gives ten in the creation procedure (p.88) and five in the Benefices chapter (p.117). Ten is the default.

ExtraPoints.Name: Extra Points at Creation
ExtraPoints.Hint: Extra points received at Step Six (p.88). Curses and Afflictions add further points on top.

Benefice.Extras: Extra points from Curses and Afflictions

Creation.Title: Character Creation
Creation.GuidedHint: Walk through Upbringing, Apprenticeship and Early Career, choosing a prebuilt stage at each.
Creation.CustomHint: Spend the points yourself on the character sheet, with no prebuilt stages.
Creation.CustomReview: Custom Creation spends the 20 characteristic and 30 skill points directly on the sheet. The Benefices and Extra points chosen here will still be applied.
Creation.FactionHint: Only stages for the chosen faction are offered. Changing it clears any stages already picked.
Creation.NoStages: No stages for this faction are in the compendium yet.
Creation.NoChoices: Nothing to decide — every stage on this path applies as printed.
Creation.ChoicesHint: Each stage offers these choices. All must be settled before continuing — a choice turns green when it is.
Creation.OpenChoice: Pick from the list. Rename the specialty on the sheet afterwards if you want something more specific.
Creation.OverCap: This path pushes traits above the starting cap. They have been reduced, freeing
Creation.FreedPoints: points to place wherever you like.
Creation.SparePoints: Points freed by a language you already knew
Creation.ApplyConfirm: Write this lifepath onto {name}? Characteristics will be set, skills raised or created, and Blessings, Curses, Benefices and the stages themselves added.
Creation.Freed: {points} point(s) were freed by the starting cap — place them on the sheet.
Creation.Locked: Character creation has already been completed. Ask your gamemaster to run it again.
Creation.ReopenWarning: Creation has already been applied to {name}. Running it again sets characteristics afresh but adds a second set of stages, Blessings, Benefices and Combat Actions on top of the existing ones. Remove the old ones first unless that is what you want.
Creation.SuggestedHint: What the rulebook proposes for this background. Advice, not a requirement — take any, all or none.
Creation.RerunTooltip: Creation already completed — click to run it again (gamemaster only)
Creation.RerunWarning: {name} has already been through character creation. Running it again will set characteristics to the new lifepath's values and add a second set of stages, Blessings and Benefices on top of the existing ones. This cannot be undone.
Creation.AllowanceHint: Your Extra Stages also allow, on top of the points below:

Blocked.Pending: Not yet available — the Psi and Theurgy compendiums are still to come.
Blocked.Full: No stages left. Drop one to take this instead.
Blocked.Exclusive: Loaded-for-Bear allows no other Extra Stages.
Blocked.ExclusiveFirst: Loaded-for-Bear may only be taken on its own.

Creation.SkillAllowanceHint: Skill levels are taken from this first, then from Extra points. Both cost one per level.

Combat.DeclareHint: Initiative is the rating of the skill you are using this turn, not a roll (p.164).
Combat.ModifierHint: A two-handed sword adds one; a Martial Hold subtracts one.
Combat.NoSkills: This character has no skills to act with.
Combat.DamageAppliedShield: {name}'s energy shield activated. {taken} wound point(s) got through; {blocked} stopped.

Occult.TabooHint: Fail this roll and the shadow grows (p.144).
Occult.DeedHint: Succeed at this roll to shed a level (p.144).
Occult.ContestNeeded: The shadow has caught up. Raising this trait needs a contest of wills first (p.135).
